media.title: Devin checks camera behavior and photo retention across iPhone Duo fold states

title: Devin verifies iPhone Duo fold states in macOS cloud VMs
summary: Nader Dabit shares demos of Devin building and checking iPhone Duo apps in macOS cloud VMs, with video verification across open, half-folded, and closed states. An iOS team can use the illustrated checks to specify state-preservation requirements, such as retaining a photo when the phone closes during a countdown or reopening a book on the same page.
takeaway: Give agents explicit checks for each fold state and transition, including interrupted actions and state restoration, and require recordings that show the result on both inner and outer screens.
